title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
description: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas).

title: The Master of Disguise
description: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities.

title: Running With Scissors
description: A man looks back on his unusual childhood, his mentally ill mother (Annette Bening) and her unorthodox therapist (Brian Cox).

title: Brian's Song
description: Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) of the Chicago Bears befriends his teammate Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher), who is dying of cancer.

title: Bless Me, Ultima
description: A young man and an elderly medicine woman try to end the battle between good and evil that is waging out of control through their village during World War II.

title: Raising Waylon
description: A restaurateur (Thomas Gibson) and a photographer (Poppy Montgomery) learn surprising things about themselves while taking care of their 9-year-old godchild.

title: Radio Flyer
description: Two boys (Elijah Wood, Joseph Mazzello) dream up a red-wagon flying machine to escape from their drunken and abusive stepfather (Adam Baldwin).
Students (Jim Sturgess, Kate Bosworth) from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology become experts at card-counting and use the skill to win big at Las Vegas casinos.

title: The International
description: An Interpol agent (Clive Owen) and a New York prosecutor (Naomi Watts) join forces to shut down a powerful bank's funding of terrorism.

title: The Interview
description: When a tabloid-TV host (James Franco) and producer (Seth Rogen) land an interview with Kim Jong-un, the CIA recruits the pair to assassinate the North Korean dictator instead.

title: Whatever It Takes
description: Two teenagers use contrived e-mails, phone calls and double dates to win their dream girls (Marla Sokoloff, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe).

title: U-Turn
description: A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other.

title: Air
description: When breathable air becomes nonexistent, two engineers (Norman Reedus, Djimon Hounsou) must guard the remaining survivors who reside in a controlled state of suspended animation.

title: Cowboy Up
description: While dreaming of becoming a champion bull-rider, a rising star (Marcus Thomas) falls for the woman (Daryl Hannah) his brother (Kiefer Sutherland) loves.

title: The Marine 6: Close Quarters
description: Jake Carter and another former Marine, Luke Trapper, join forces to rescue a kidnapped girl from a gang of international criminals.

title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day
description: Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower (Tom Selleck) faces monumental decisions in the 90 days leading to the Allied invasion of Normandy in 1944.

title: The Shadow Riders
description: Two brothers who fought on opposite sides during the American Civil War return home to their family kidnapped by rebels. So now they put aside their differences to rescue them.

title: Places in the Heart
description: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm with a laborer and a blind boarder in the 1930s Texas.

title: Philadelphia
description: Fired by his firm, a lawyer (Tom Hanks) with AIDS fights back in court with help from his lawyer (Denzel Washington).

title: Radio Flyer
description: Two boys (Elijah Wood, Joseph Mazzello) dream up a red-wagon flying machine to escape from their drunken and abusive stepfather (Adam Baldwin).

title: Facing the Giants
description: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.

title: The Deep
description: New Yorkers (Jacqueline Bisset, Nick Nolte) go scuba diving in Bermuda and find morphine from World War II on top of a Spanish galleon.

title: Darkness Falls
description: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.

title: Red Water
description: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.

title: Maximum Risk
description: Federal agents and the Russian Mafia chase a French policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) on a mission in New York City.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

title: Felon
description: A new convict (Stephen Dorff) struggles to maintain his sanity and sense of humanity after he's thrust into a prison system in which a brutal guard (Harold Perrineau) encourages gladiatorial combat between inmates.

title: The Take
description: During his rehabilitation after he is shot during a heist in East L.A., an armored truck driver tracks down the man who committed the crime.

title: U-Turn
description: A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other.

title: Money Train
description: A New York transit officer (Woody Harrelson) fights subway crime with his foster brother (Wesley Snipes) and dreams of robbing the train carrying system revenue.

title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
description: A husband (Hugh Grant) and wife (Sarah Jessica Parker) get a chance to repair their crumbling marriage when, after they witness a murder, federal agents hide them in a tiny Wyoming town.

title: Bewitched
description: An actual witch (Nicole Kidman) and a neurotic movie star (Will Ferrell) land the lead roles in a television remake of the 1960s sitcom.

title: Persuasion
description: When Frederick Wentworth -- the one who got away -- crashes back into Anne Elliot's life, she must choose between putting the past behind her or listening to her heart when it comes to second chances.

title: Swept From the Sea
description: Locals disapprove of the love between an indentured servant (Rachel Weisz) and the shipwrecked Russian (Vincent Perez) she rescued in 19th-century England.

title: Breakout
description: A woman (Jill Ireland) hires a bush pilot (Charles Bronson) to free her husband (Robert Duvall), framed for a murder, from a Mexican prison.

title: Birdy
description: A Vietnam veteran helps his bird-obsessed boyhood buddy in a psychiatric hospital.

title: Murphy's Romance
description: A divorced mother (Sally Field) moves to an Arizona ranch and meets a widowed pharmacist (James Garner) twice her age.
